# Three.js r180 (0.180.0)

Vendored from https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz.
Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

Files are unmodified: `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`, and
`examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`. The MIT license is in
`THREE-LICENSE.txt`. The browser import map resolves the addon's `three`
import locally. No CDN, npm installation, GLB, or network access is needed
for rendering. Google Fonts is optional; CSS includes local system fallbacks.

`team/generate_assets.py` records file checksums in `web/manifest.json`.
